description: The main window, and the window controls the tray + close-to-tray lifecycle and the startup probe drive (close/hide/show). App-defined and Rust-fired commands (incl. the Rust-side notification, the updater plugin and the opener, all driven from Rust) need no ACL entry in Tauri v2; core:default covers the window basics, including is-visible, and the event listen the update-available banner uses.
